fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (V) reported Q4 adjusted EPS of $3.48, exceeding the $3.44 expectation, but the share price fell 2.3% after-hours due to 2027 fiscal year guidance of low double-digit growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: 2027 revenue growth rate and adjusted EPS are expected to moderate to low double-digit to low-teen range, decelerating from 2026 adjusted EPS growth of 16%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Fiscal year revenue reached $4.59 billion (+15%), adjusted EPS of $13.27 (+16%), and net income of $2.35 billion (+17%), marking a milestone year, with quarterly dividend also increased.
